papers.title: Uncovering the coupled impact of defect morphology and microstructure on the tensile behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated via laser powder bed fusion
papers.first_author_affiliation: Research and Exploratory Development Department, the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL), Laurel, MD, 20723, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Steven Storck
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research and Exploratory Development Department, the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL), Laurel, MD, 20723, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷和微观结构对拉伸性能的影响，但未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或多孔结构匹配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, porous structure, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究缺陷形态与微观结构对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V拉伸性能的耦合影响
summary_zh.method: 通过拉伸实验分析不同缺陷形态和微观结构下的力学行为
summary_zh.result: 缺陷形态和微观结构对拉伸性能有显著影响
summary_zh.validation: 采用机械拉伸测试进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand how defect morphology and microstructure interact to influence the tensile behavior of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental tensile testing was conducted on LPBF Ti-6Al-4V specimens with various defect characteristics and microstructural states.
summary_en.result: The coupling of defect morphology and microstructure significantly affects the tensile properties, including strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through standardized mechanical tensile tests on as-fabricated specimens.

papers.title: Effects of sub-atmospheric pressure on keyhole dynamics and porosity in products fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, School of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, 50 Nanyang Avenue, Singapore, 639798, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Kun Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Singapore Centre for 3D Printing, School of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, 50 Nanyang Avenue, Singapore, 639798, Singapore

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注SLM工艺参数优化（负压减少孔隙），未涉及植入物设计或力学性能，与生物医用金属研究方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on keyhole porosity reduction under sub-atmospheric pressure.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究负压对选区激光熔化中匙孔动力学和孔隙率的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验观察和数值模拟分析不同气压下的熔池行为。
summary_zh.result: 发现负压可抑制匙孔不稳定性并减少孔隙。
summary_zh.validation: 使用高速摄像和显微CT验证孔隙率变化。

summary_en.motivation: To understand how sub-atmospheric pressure affects keyhole behavior and porosity in selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Combined experimental observation of melt pool dynamics under varying pressures with numerical simulations.
summary_en.result: Reducing ambient pressure suppresses keyhole fluctuations and decreases porosity in fabricated parts.
summary_en.validation: Validated by high-speed imaging of keyhole dynamics and micro-CT porosity measurements.

papers.title: Effect of laser remelting on surface roughness and microstructure of AlSi10Mg selective laser melting manufactured parts
papers.first_author_affiliation: Sapienza Università di Roma, DIMA, via Eudossiana 18, 00184, Rome, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Alberto Boschetto
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Sapienza Università di Roma, DIMA, via Eudossiana 18, 00184, Rome, Italy

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究AlSi10Mg激光重熔对表面粗糙度和微观结构的影响，但与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration; focus is solely on surface quality of a non-biomedical alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM制件表面粗糙度与微观结构
summary_zh.method: 采用激光重熔技术处理AlSi10Mg合金表面
summary_zh.result: 激光重熔降低了表面粗糙度并改变了微观组织
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面轮廓仪和扫描电镜表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve surface quality and microstructure of additively manufactured AlSi10Mg parts via laser remelting.
summary_en.method: Laser remelting was applied to the surface of selective laser melted AlSi10Mg specimens.
summary_en.result: Laser remelting reduced surface roughness and modified the microstructure, achieving a smoother surface.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness measurements and scanning electron microscopy were used to characterize the as-remelted surfaces.
